title: Onsite Medical Representative
description:
Application deadline: Aug 3, 2026

Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

title: Chatbot Developer (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) - Freelance
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations within our hybrid AI + human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot – that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift – you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide bot engineering expertise, conversational design judgment, and quality control to ensure bots are reliable, useful, and ready for real users. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Evaluate AI-generated bot code and refactor it for correctness, reliability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

title: Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure
description:
Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement enterprise-grade Azure cloud architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, identity, and data services, with explicit attention to scalability, security, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code through version control and peer review.
  • Configure and manage Azure landing zones, virtual networks, subnets, route tables, and network security groups to enforce strong segmentation and least-privilege connectivity between workloads.
  • Implement secure identity, access management, and governance controls using Azure Active Directory, conditional access, role-based access control, and Azure Policy to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
  • Architect and operate Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pool design, auto-scaling, network policy, and integration with container registries and service meshes.
  • Deploy, scale, and tune Azure data and analytics platforms such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, and Event Hubs to meet specific workload patterns and SLAs.
  • Build and operate comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling fast, automated, and auditable releases of both infrastructure and application code.
  • Design and implement robust observability practices using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and third-party tooling, with thoughtful dashboards, alerting, and SLO tracking.
  • Drive Azure cost optimization initiatives, including right-sizing, reserved-instance planning, lifecycle policies, and architectural changes that meaningfully reduce monthly cloud spend.
  • Implement disaster-recovery and business-continuity strategies, including backup, geo-replication, failover testing, and documented runbooks that have been validated through regular drills.
  • Strengthen security posture by integrating Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, key vault, and managed identities, and by routinely remediating findings from compliance scans.
  • Collaborate closely with application teams to architect cloud-native solutions, advising on patterns, anti-patterns, and Azure-native services that best fit each problem domain.
  • Develop automation scripts and tooling in PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline repetitive operational work and reduce time-to-resolution for common incidents.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead architecture reviews, and contribute actively to internal communities of practice around Azure and DevOps.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
  • Experience operating hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd on AKS.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost-management tooling.
  • Experience with regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.

Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. Job Description:

3M Health Care to teraz Solventum

W Solventum umożliwiamy lepszą, inteligentniejszą i bezpieczniejszą opiekę zdrowotną, aby poprawić jakość życia. Jako nowa firma z długą tradycją tworzenia przełomowych rozwiązań dla najtrudniejszych wyzwań naszych klientów, jesteśmy pionierami przełomowych innowacji na styku zdrowia, materiałoznawstwa i nauki o danych, które zmieniają życie pacjentów na lepsze, jednocześnie umożliwiając pracownikom służby zdrowia osiąganie najlepszych wyników. title: Product Manager, Vice President - Privileged Access Management
description:
Shape the future of cybersecurity and product innovation by delivering solutions that enhance, secure, and simplify how access is requested, approved, and audited. You will define the strategy, roadmap, and adoption of next-generation Privileged Access Management capabilities that provide secure, seamless, and auditable access for both human and non-human identities.

As a Product Manager, Vice President at JPMorganChase within Corporate Technology, Identity and Access Management, you will partner with engineering, cybersecurity, risk, and customer teams to deliver scalable solutions that address complex security challenges and enable business outcomes. You will translate needs into clear product direction, prioritize investments using data and customer feedback, and drive adoption through effective change management. You will help modernize privileged access patterns while maintaining a strong focus on operational excellence and control alignment.

Job responsibilities

  • Define and communicate product strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for Privileged Access Management capabilities
  • Drive modernization of privileged access patterns through just-in-time access, passwordless approaches, and least-privilege controls to improve security and user experience
  • Partner with engineering and architecture to translate customer needs into well-defined requirements, integrations, and platform capabilities
  • Manage delivery plans, timelines, cross-functional dependencies, and risk mitigation to meet commitments and reduce delivery friction
  • Lead onboarding, communications, and change management to increase adoption and sustained, effective use of privileged access services
  • Analyze adoption metrics, operational data, and customer feedback to identify trends and inform prioritization and investment decisions
  • Develop executive-ready reporting that provides visibility into adoption, operational health, delivery progress, and business outcomes
  • Ensure product capabilities align to enterprise risk and control expectations while prioritizing customer success and reliability

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Formal training or certification on product engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • 5+ years of experience delivering cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management, Privileged Access Management, platform, or enterprise technology products in partnership with engineering teams
  • Deep knowledge of Privileged Access Management principles, controls, and security best practices, including auditability and least privilege
  • Hands-on experience in one or more Privileged Access Management domains such as just-in-time access, role-based access control, credential vaulting, secrets management, or privileged session management
  • Experience defining product requirements for APIs, integrations, and technical solutions for enterprise security platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across engineering, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and operations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including defining success metrics and measuring outcomes using data
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear executive updates and drive alignment

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Experience with cloud-based identity and privileged access architectures across Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Familiarity with modern access management patterns, including Zero Trust and workload or machine identity
  • Experience using analytics, visualization, and reporting tools to guide product decisions and adoption strategies
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, automation, resiliency concepts, and modern software delivery principles
  • Experience using AI-powered tools to improve discovery, requirements definition, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communicationsan identities across hybrid and cloud environments.

title: STR MGMT/e-COMMERCE SUPERVISOR 348
description:

  • Interview, select and hire candidates to staff the on-line shopping department
  • Meet the demands of product flow and create schedules according to guidelines
  • Develop associates to meet the productivity standards and certify associates once they meet or exceed goals
  • Confirm that associates are following local, state, and federal laws in addition to all food safety procedures and company guidelines

  • Execute best practices to determine appropriate substitutions in the event of an out of stock

  • Monitor and control expenses for the department
  • Ensure preventative maintenance is being performed on all equipment in the department
  • Supervise and coach direct reports in the performance of their duties; complete performance reviews and provide feedback to direct reports
  • Ability to work cooperatively in high paced and sometimes stressful environment
  • Ability to manage conflict in a reasonable, nonconfrontational and cooperative manner
  • Ability to act with honesty and integrity regarding customer and business information
  • Ability to follow directions and seek assistance when necessary to resolve customer and business issues
  • Provide support and assistance through direct interaction with minors, individuals with special needs, and/or older adults
  • Must be able to perform the essential job functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation

MINIMUM

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Any proven supervisory experience
  • Any prior experience in the selection and hiring process
  • Strong organization skills
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds frequently and up to 50 pounds several throughout the day
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time and/or walk constantly
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, or crouch several times per hour
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Excellent oral/written communication skills
  • Strong leadership skills

DESIRED

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Any experience with and knowledge of Point of Sale (POS)

title: Programme Coordinator
description:
As we scale the Founders Factory model across new sectors and internationally we are seeking an enthusiastic, self-starter to help us manage the delivery of our programmes and events. This role will sit at the centre of our Studio and Accelerator operations, supporting ventures and their founders as they move through our programmes. You'll be responsible for the administrative duties, operations and the execution of the program once new investments have been made: onboarding new founders, scheduling new programmes, coordinating events, capturing feedback, and monitoring engagement. You will work closely with our Head of Operations and Chief Studio Officer to ensure we are delivering on our offer to founders, tracking against our company-wide objectives, and creating exceptional value for start-ups as they scale.

Responsibilities

Programme Delivery

  • You will coordinate the day-to-day running of our Studio and Accelerator programmes: scheduling meetings, tracking notes, and sharing recordings, consolidating data points

  • You will help to create a strong culture within our programmes, creating a sense of community across cohorts and founders, ensuring our group communication channels are maintained, helping to drive engagement across programmes and founders.

  • You will be responsible for founder onboarding, ensuring they have access to all relevant tooling (including Notion, Slack, and the FF App), connecting founders with the correct team members, and sharing program specific resources.

  • You will set up new cohorts, creating Google Groups, and setting up our FF App for each new programme.

  • You will manage our Founder Perks and Benefits, onboarding new partner offerings and managing outreach to new potential partners.

  • Support and collect feedback that allows us to improve and iterate on our offering and support; setting up relevant 1-1's with founders to learn from their experience working with us and flagging areas for improvement.

  • Maintain data collection to enable automatic reporting on ventures and programmes, ensuring key company data and feedback is captured and shared via Airtable.

Event Coordination

  • You will help plan and coordinate our founder events calendar, including sector/cohort specific in-person showcases, sponsored alumni socials, virtual fireside chats and panels.

  • You will source suitable event spaces and liaise with the venue stakeholders to ensure all requirements are met for the event, this would include on contracts, payments and on the day logistics

  • You will manage guest lists for any events, creating event invites using Luma,. , managing attendance and sending relevant communications to stakeholders and guests

  • You will capture feedback from events and ensure we are measuring impact. You can will then feed any relevant data points in the ongoing development of the events calendar

Requirements

  • Be highly organised, data focused, and quick to take action.

  • Be curious about technology and digital tooling, with an interest in AI and automations.

  • Be very comfortable with managing databases.

  • Experience in operations, project management, events, or administrative roles is a plus.

  • Understand and be able to talk about early-stage business development, and having an understanding of what is needed to scale new ventures.

  • Have exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.

  • Have high emotional intelligence and empathy for founders and their team as well as for your fellow colleagues in the Founders Factory team.

  • This role would suit a recent university graduate or someone with between 1 and 3 years experience - who wants to work in a fast paced tech environment.

title: Dental Hygiene Assistant
description:
Overview

Dental Health Associates is looking for a Dental Hygienist Assistant in Lexington, Virginia, to join our clinical team. We are committed in providing a high level of patient care and satisfaction while operating team-based environment. We take pride in providing comprehensive, personalized care in warm and welcoming environment, prioritizing patient comfort and advanced treatments for optimal oral health.

Position Overview:

As a Dental Hygiene Assistant, you are an integral part of care team in providing support to the office and assisting the professional dental staff with treatment. We are passionate about preventive oral health care and value our hygiene team. Join our dynamic dental practice as a Dental Hygiene Assistant! We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care in supportive, friendly environment with opportunities for professional growth. Candidates must have prior dental assisting experience to be considered.

What we offer:

  • Competitive Pay range
  • Full time: Tuesday-Friday
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (individual and family coverage)
  • Life insurance and disability benefits
  • 401(k)
  • Support for professional growth and continuing education
  • Team-oriented work environment with access to modern dental technology

How to Apply:We are excited to meet you! Apply today with your resume using the link below.

Be part of our journey to shape the future of dentistry. Apply today to join our mission-driven team!

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and set up treatment rooms, ensuring cleanliness and proper sterilization
  • Assist Dental Hygienists during patient treatment progress
  • Update patient health history and chart treatment progress
  • Expose and develop radiographs (if certified)
  • Educate patients on proper oral hygiene and preventive care
  • Cordinate with clinical staff to manage inventory and sterilization of dental instruments

  • Perform routine tasks while ensuring compliance with the industry regulations including HIPAA & OSHA

  • CPR certification (Preferred but can be obtained upon hiring)

  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to patient care and comfort

title: Chiropractor Baton Rouge LA
description:
Chiropractor Baton Rouge LA
We are seeking a motivated Chiropractor to join our well-established practice in Baton Rouge, LA. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate, patient-focused chiropractor who enjoys building lasting relationships, delivering exceptional care, and working as part of a supportive team. Must have strong adjusting skills and be a team player who truly enjoys helping others reach their health and wellness goals.
Why Join Our Practice?
For over 15 years, we've helped patients achieve lasting pain relief, improved function, and better overall health through personalized chiropractic care. Our modern clinic offers digital X-rays, electrical stimulation, traction therapy, rehabilitation exercises, and other advanced therapies to support outstanding patient outcomes. You'll work alongside an experienced team in a positive, collaborative environment where you can focus on providing high-quality care.
Duties:
  • Perform comprehensive patient evaluations and examinations
  • Develop individualized treatment plans

Job Title: Advanced Tree Trimmer

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026

Job Summary:

The Advanced Tree Trimmer role is a qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer responsible for pruning and removing trees, limbs and shrubs away from power lines to reduce vegetation interference. This role utilizes various types of equipment, tools, and techniques to perform advanced tree care while addressing growth patterns and ensuring tree health, and appearance.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Works aloft to cut branches or trunk sections and drop or lower them to the ground with rigging lines.

  • Uses appropriate tools on the ground to fell trees or spars and split them into manageable pieces.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and may work in close proximity to energized power lines while providing direct supervision of the activities of non-qualified employees working in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Applies herbicide with growth regulators to brush and stumps. Maintains appropriate application records.

  • Adheres to and helps educate less experienced employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods and OSHA regulations.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Feeds brush and debris into woodchipper.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty for the duration of the disaster.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

  • May assist with obtaining written permission from property owners. Helps promote and maintain good customer and public relations as well as with employees.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and coach employees on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to comprehend and/or read and write both written and verbal job instructions and safety information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 1 year of experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred, but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

Language Requirements (read, write, speak):

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Spanish - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Other Language _________________ - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Travel Requirements:

☐No-Seldom

☐Yes-Occasional (up to 5%)

☐Yes-Moderate (5% to 25%)

☐Yes-Substantial (25% to 50%)

☒Yes-Extensive (greater than 50%)

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Possesses the ability to lift, move, and maneuver up to 50 pounds on an infrequent basis and up to 30 pounds on a frequent basis.

  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.

  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

Environmental Factors:

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to indoor and outdoor working conditions.

  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.

  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.

  • Routine exposure to noise, vibration, working hazards such as proximity to moving parts, mechanical equipment, moving vehicles, gasoline powered equipment, electrical current, heights, exposure to heat, exposure to chemicals, work in close quarters, narrow aisles or passageways, communicable diseases, bloodborne pathogens, cleaning chemicals, dust, odors, and a variety of pests.

Cargo: Advanced Tree Trimmer

Tipo de salario: No exento

Fecha de creación/Fecha de revisión: 04/24/2026

Resumen del puesto:

El Advanced Tree Trimmer es un Qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer (podador calificado para el despeje de líneas) responsable de podar y retirar árboles, ramas y arbustos cerca de las líneas eléctricas para reducir la interferencia de la vegetación. La persona en esta función utiliza diversos equipos, herramientas y técnicas para realizar cuidados avanzados de los árboles, considerando patrones de crecimiento y asegurando la salud y apariencia del árbol.

Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.

  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.

  • Trabaja en altura para cortar ramas o secciones de tronco y bajarlas al suelo con cuerdas de aparejo.

  • Utiliza herramientas apropiadas en el suelo para talar árboles o troncos caídos y dividirlos en piezas fáciles de manipular.

  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y puede desempeñarse en proximidad a líneas energizadas mientras supervisa directamente las actividades de empleados no calificados que trabajan cerca de conductores energizados.

  • Aplica herbicidas con reguladores de crecimiento a la maleza (brush) y los troncos. Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.

  • Cumple y ayuda a capacitar a empleados con menos experiencia sobre las políticas de la empresa, los procedimientos, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de OSHA.

  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.

  • Introduce maleza (brush) y residuos en la astilladora.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson. sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio durante la duración del evento.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y de propiedad de empleados de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

  • Puede asistir en la obtención de permisos escritos de los propietarios de las propiedades. Ayuda a promover y mantener buenas relaciones con clientes, público y empleados.

Funciones de supervisión:

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.

  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con el público, los clientes y los empleados.

  • Conocimiento y comprensión de American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para Operaciones de Cuidado de Árboles - ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de American National Standards for Proper Pruning (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la Poda Adecuada - ANSI A300).

  • Capacidad para cumplir y capacitar a los empleados sobre los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.

  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.

  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.

  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.

  • Capacidad para comprender o leer y escribir tanto las instrucciones laborales como la información de seguridad, en forma escrita y verbal.

  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.

  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.

  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.

  • Conocimiento y capacitación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).

  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.

  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Contar con un mínimo de 1 año de experiencia trabajando en equipos de poda o despeje de árboles, o haber completado con éxito las evaluaciones de habilidades correspondientes.

  • Se prefiere diploma de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.

  • Debe contar con credenciales vigentes de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR), o poder obtenerlas en un plazo de 90 días tras la contratación.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Department of Transportation (Departamento de Transporte, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de FMCSA.

  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.

  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.

  • Mantenerse informado sobre nuevos equipos, especificaciones, normas, prácticas y procedimientos operativos.

Requisitos de idioma (leer, escribir, hablar):

Inglés: ☒ leer, ☒ escribir, ☒ hablar

Características físicas:

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

  • Flexionarse, estirarse, permanecer de pie, caminar, trepar, levantar, cargar, sujetar, hablar, oír y realizar movimientos repetitivos de manera efectiva. Ocasionalmente alcanzar hacia arriba o hacia abajo.

  • Ejercer hasta 100 libras (45 kg) de fuerza ocasionalmente o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza con frecuencia, o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza de manera constante para mover objetos.

  • Poseer la capacidad para levantar, mover y maniobrar hasta 50 libras (23 kg) ocasionalmente y hasta 30 libras (14 kg) con frecuencia.

  • Debe tener agudeza visual suficiente para determinar la precisión, limpieza y exhaustividad del trabajo asignado o para hacer observaciones generales del entorno; agudeza visual cercana, como para leer una pantalla de computadora, materiales impresos, inspeccionar defectos pequeños o utilizar instrumentos de medición.

  • Poder entrar y salir de vehículos y equipos varias veces al día.

Factores ambientales:

Las personas en este puesto pueden estar expuestas a los siguientes factores:

  • Exposición habitual a condiciones de trabajo tanto interiores como exteriores.

  • Exposición habitual a las condiciones meteorológicas, climáticas y de temperatura, como lluvia, calor, sol, frío y nieve.

  • Exposición habitual a la naturaleza, como plantas irritantes, insectos que pican o muerden, polvo, etc.; el puesto se desarrolla al aire libre en terrenos irregulares.

  • Exposición habitual a ruido, vibraciones, peligros laborales como la proximidad a piezas móviles, equipos mecánicos, vehículos en movimiento, equipos con motor de gasolina, corriente eléctrica, alturas, calor, productos químicos, espacios reducidos, pasillos o conductos estrechos, enfermedades transmisibles, patógenos de transmisión sanguínea, productos de limpieza, polvo, olores y diversos tipos de plagas.

DECLARACIONES DE LA EMPRESA (solo EE. UU.):

Las funciones, responsabilidades y actividades pueden modificarse en cualquier momento, con o sin previo aviso.

title: Director, Evidence Generation and Publications
description:
About this opportunity:

Freenome is seeking a Director, Evidence Generation and Publications to lead integrated evidence-generation and publication strategies across the company’s portfolio.

This role will identify evidence gaps, develop research and analysis plans, and oversee the dissemination of clinical, real-world, economic, and operational data. The Director will partner across Scientific and Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Data Science, Regulatory Affairs and Market Access.

The ideal candidate is a strategic scientific leader with deep experience in evidence generation, publication planning, and cross-functional collaboration.

This role reports to the VP, Medical Affairs. This role will be a Remote role.

What you’ll do:

Evidence-generation strategy

  • Develop and execute integrated evidence plans aligned with clinical, regulatory, market-access, and commercial priorities.
  • Identify evidence gaps and translate them into readily executable research questions, study concepts, and analysis plans.
  • Lead post hoc analyses, real-world evidence and registry studies, and investigator-sponsored research.
  • Guide evidence development throughout the product lifecycle (feasibility, validation, and post-marketing studies).
  • Establish clear governance, prioritization, timelines, and measures of impact.

Publication and scientific-dissemination strategy

  • Develop and manage publication plans aligned with Freenome’s scientific communication strategy.
  • Oversee manuscripts, abstracts, posters, oral presentations, and other scientific materials.
  • Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant dissemination of data.
  • Partner with internal authors, external investigators, medical writers, statisticians, and third-party vendors.
  • Track publication progress and scientific impact.

Scientific leadership and cross-functional collaboration

  • Serve as a strategic partner across Science, Scientific and Medical Affairs, Clinical, Regulatory, Market Access, Commercial,, and Biometrics.
  • Translate complex findings into clear and credible scientific narratives.
  • Provide guidance on study design, endpoints, analyses, interpretation, and dissemination.
  • Align internal teams on evidence priorities, scientific messaging, and publication timing.
  • Present strategies and program updates to senior leadership.

External research and scientific engagement

  • Represent Freenome at scientific congresses, advisory boards, and research meetings.
  • Build relationships with investigators, academic institutions and healthcare systems.
  • Evaluate and support investigator-sponsored.
  • Identify external partnerships that strengthen Freenome’s evidence base.

Governance, quality, and compliance

  • Ensure adherence to applicable company policies, publication standards, and ethical guidelines, including GPP and ICMJE.
  • Maintain high standards for scientific integrity, authorship, transparency, and data accuracy.

title: Lead, GTM Strategy & Transformation
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Our Strategy and Business Operations is a focused team that works on our most critical business challenges to drive and support our industry-leading growth. Your efforts will directly affect the overall strategy and success of a world-leading cybersecurity business. You will collaborate on complex business and technology problems that are top of mind for our executives. You possess a unique blend of business insight, business strategy experience, big-picture thinking, and influencing skills and the ability to collaborate with a large number of constituents within Palo Alto Networks.

As a Principal in our GTM Strategy team, you will tackle the most mission-critical initiatives in our Business organization to deliver industry-leading growth. This role works directly with senior GTM leadership to solve complex strategy problems, from supercharging direct sales to evolving our global GTM model. You will have unprecedented access to our CEO, President and GTM leadership, and this role is a launchpad for future leadership positions across the company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with GTM leaders to develop and architect our cohesive GTM strategy and ongoing transformation, proactively identifying and prioritizing initiatives.

  • Combine your core strategy toolkit (framing, hypothesis-driven approach, data-driven insight) with business judgment to lead and deliver major GTM initiatives.

  • Act as an advisor and sounding board for senior GTM leaders on acceleration efforts, strategic organizational choices, and other critical decisions.

  • Drive complex cross-functional efforts, from material GTM model changes to the acceleration of $1B+ businesses and major cultural change.

  • Lead and support strategic GTM presentations for E-Staff, Board of Directors, and others on behalf of our GTM leaders.

  • Work cross-functionally with other strategy teams, business operations, finance, and IT to see efforts through to operationalization and outcomes.

  • Drive change across the organization and be willing to wear multiple hats (strategy, project management, execution) to move the needle.

  • Serve as a Player-Coach that raises the capabilities of everyone around you.

  • Experience in building relationships and leading through influence

  • Experience managing projects and large-scale transformations

Team Overview

Experience Management is DiDi Premier's quality audit function: we measure driver SOP compliance, run service-level assessments, and generate the data that tells us whether Premier's service standards are actually being delivered on the ground. We sit at the intersection of field operations, enforcement, and driver education — translating audit results into actionable insights that drive program decisions across the organization.

As an intern in Experience Management, you will support the team's analytical and documentation work at a critical moment: Premier is actively building and refining its driver enforcement and education systems, and EM is responsible for measuring whether those systems are working. You will help turn raw audit data into structured analysis, contribute to process documentation, and use AI tools to automate repetitive workflows — freeing the team to focus on higher-order decisions.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will work closely with Supply Development and Driver Ecosystem, and your outputs will directly inform how we calibrate Premier's quality programs.

Role Responsibilities

  • Running structured analyses to measure the impact of Premier's driver enforcement and education systems — tracking how compliance, service scores, and audit outcomes evolve over time.
  • Leading service-level measurement initiatives to assess driver compliance and service quality, and building the analytical tools and dashboards that support ongoing monitoring of EM's key indicators.
  • Supporting process documentation across EM's operating workflows — audit SOPs, scoring criteria, escalation flows — ensuring the team's institutional knowledge is captured in structured, usable formats.
  • Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive EM processes using AI tools, and implementing those automations with the team's guidance.
  • Collaborating with Supply Development and Driver Ecosystem at the working level to share audit findings and support cross-functional decision making.

Role Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate processes, generate documentation, or accelerate analytical work.
  • Strong written communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • A structured, detail-oriented working style.
  • Genuine curiosity about how driver behavior, service quality, and program design connect to each other.

  • Assures that appropriate resources (personnel, tools, etc.) are maintained in order to assure Quality System compliance and adherence to the BSC Quality Policy.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Quality, Regulatory, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience as a Quality System Steward, process owner, sub-process steward, global document owner, or similar quality system governance role.

Job Title: Tree Trimmer

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026

Job Summary:

The Tree Trimmer role is a qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer responsible for pruning and removing trees, limbs and shrubs away from power lines to reduce vegetation interference. This role utilizes various types of equipment, tools, and techniques to perform basic tree maintenance while addressing growth patterns and ensuring tree health, and appearance.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Works aloft to cut branches or trunk sections and drop or lower them to the ground with rigging lines.

  • Uses appropriate tools on the ground to fell trees or spars and split them into manageable pieces.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and may work in close proximity to energized power lines while under the direct supervision of a qualified line clearance tree trimmer. Once the prerequisites for qualification have been met, may provide direct supervision of the activities of non-qualified employees working in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Applies herbicide and growth regulators to brush and stumps. Maintains appropriate application records.

  • Adheres to and helps educate less experienced employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods and OSHA regulations.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occurs on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Feeds brush and debris into woodchipper.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Must have basic knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and coach employees on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to comprehend and/or read and write both written and verbal job instructions and safety information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 3 months of experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred, but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

Language Requirements (read, write, speak):

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Spanish - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Other Language _________________ - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Travel Requirements:

☐No-Seldom

☐Yes-Occasional (up to 5%)

☐Yes-Moderate (5% to 25%)

☐Yes-Substantial (25% to 50%)

☒Yes-Extensive (greater than 50%)

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Possesses the ability to lift, move, and maneuver up to 50 pounds on an infrequent basis and up to 30 pounds on a frequent basis.

  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.

  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

Environmental Factors:

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to indoor and outdoor working conditions.

  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.

  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.

  • Routine exposure to noise, vibration, working hazards such as proximity to moving parts, mechanical equipment, moving vehicles, gasoline powered equipment, electrical current, heights, exposure to heat, exposure to chemicals, work in close quarters, narrow aisles or passageways, communicable diseases, bloodborne pathogens, cleaning chemicals, dust, odors, and a variety of pests.

Cargo: Tree Trimmer

Tipo de salario: No exento

Fecha de creación/Fecha de revisión: 04/24/2026

Resumen del puesto:

El Tree Trimmer es un Qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer (podador calificado para el despeje de líneas) responsable de podar y retirar árboles, ramas y arbustos cerca de las líneas eléctricas para reducir la interferencia de la vegetación. La persona en esta función utiliza diversos equipos, herramientas y técnicas para realizar mantenimiento básico de los árboles, teniendo en cuenta los patrones de crecimiento y la salud y apariencia de los árboles.

Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño manejable que no pueden ser triturados.

  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de escalada, como camión con elevador de poda, cinturón de seguridad, cuerda de escalada y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de uso en el suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.

  • Trabaja en altura para cortar ramas o secciones de tronco y bajarlas al suelo con cuerdas de izado.

  • Utiliza herramientas apropiadas en el suelo para talar árboles o troncos y dividirlos en piezas fáciles de manipular.

  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y puede desempeñarse en proximidad a líneas energizadas bajo la supervisión directa de un Qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer (podador calificado para el despeje de líneas). Una vez cumplidos los requisitos para la calificación, puede supervisar directamente las actividades de empleados no calificados que trabajan cerca de conductores energizados.

  • Aplica herbicidas y reguladores de crecimiento a la maleza (brush) y los troncos. Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.

  • Cumple y ayuda a capacitar a empleados con menos experiencia sobre las políticas de la empresa, los procedimientos, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de la Administración de Salud Ocupacional (OSHA).

  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.

  • Alimenta la trituradora de madera con maleza y residuos.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson. sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de pertenencia de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Debe tener conocimientos básicos sobre los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.

  • Conocimiento y comprensión de las normas nacionales estadounidenses para operaciones de cuidado de árboles (ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la poda adecuada (ANSI A300).

  • Capacidad para cumplir y capacitar a los empleados sobre los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.

  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.

  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de la OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.

  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.

  • Capacidad para comprender o leer y escribir tanto las instrucciones laborales como la información de seguridad, en forma escrita y verbal.

  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.

  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.

  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.

  • Conocimiento y formación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).

  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.

  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Contar con un mínimo de 3 meses de experiencia trabajando en cuadrillas de poda o despeje de árboles, o haber completado con éxito las evaluaciones de habilidades correspondientes.

  • Se prefiere título de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.

  • Debe contar con credenciales vigentes de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR), o poder obtenerlas en un plazo de 90 días tras la contratación.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Departamento de Transporte (Department of Transportation, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de la FMCSA.

  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.

  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.

  • Mantenerse informado sobre nuevos equipos, especificaciones, normas, prácticas y procedimientos operativos.

Requisitos de idioma (leer, escribir, hablar):

Inglés: ☒ leer, ☒ escribir, ☒ hablar

Español: ☐ leer, ☐ escribir, ☐ hablar

Otro idioma _________________ - ☐ leer, ☐ escribir, ☐ hablar

☐Sí, moderado (del 5 % al 25 %)

☐Sí, sustancial (del 25 % al 50 %)

☒Sí, extenso (más del 50 %)

Características físicas:

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

  • Flexionarse, estirarse, permanecer de pie, caminar, trepar, levantar, cargar, sujetar, hablar, oír y realizar movimientos repetitivos de manera efectiva. Ocasionalmente alcanzar hacia arriba o hacia abajo.

  • Ejercer hasta 100 libras (45 kg) de fuerza ocasionalmente o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza con frecuencia, o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza de manera constante para mover objetos.

  • Poseer la capacidad para levantar, mover y maniobrar hasta 50 libras (23 kg) ocasionalmente y hasta 30 libras (14 kg) con frecuencia.

  • Debe tener agudeza visual suficiente para determinar la precisión, pulcritud y exhaustividad del trabajo asignado o para hacer observaciones generales del entorno; agudeza visual cercana, como para leer una pantalla de computadora, materiales impresos, inspeccionar defectos pequeños o utilizar instrumentos de medición.

  • Poder entrar y salir de vehículos y equipos varias veces al día.

Factores ambientales:

Las personas en este puesto pueden estar expuestas a los siguientes factores:

  • Exposición habitual a condiciones de trabajo tanto interiores como exteriores.

  • Exposición habitual a las condiciones meteorológicas, climáticas y de temperatura, como lluvia, calor, sol, frío y nieve.

  • Exposición habitual a la naturaleza, como plantas irritantes, insectos que pican o muerden, polvo, etc.; el puesto se desarrolla al aire libre en terrenos irregulares.

  • Exposición habitual a ruido, vibraciones, peligros laborales como la proximidad a piezas móviles, equipos mecánicos, vehículos en movimiento, equipos con motor de gasolina, corriente eléctrica, alturas, calor, productos químicos, espacios reducidos, pasillos o conductos estrechos, enfermedades transmisibles, patógenos de transmisión sanguínea, productos de limpieza, polvo, olores y diversos tipos de plagas.

DECLARACIONES DE LA EMPRESA (solo EE. UU.):

Funciones del puesto: esta descripción del puesto no está diseñada para abarcar ni contener una lista exhaustiva de todas las actividades, tareas o responsabilidades requeridas del empleado. Las funciones, responsabilidades y actividades pueden modificarse en cualquier momento, con o sin previo aviso.

Igualdad de oportunidades de empleo: Wright Service Corp. respeta la diversidad y es un empleador inclusivo y con igualdad de oportunidades que no discrimina por motivos de raza, color, credo, religión, nacionalidad, ascendencia, ciudadanía, edad, sexo o género (incluidos embarazo, parto, condiciones médicas relacionadas y lactancia), identidad o expresión de género (incluido el estado de persona transgénero), orientación sexual, estado civil, servicio militar o condición de veterano, discapacidad física o mental, condición médica protegida, información genética o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación, norma o reglamento federal, estatal o local aplicable. Nos comprometemos a garantizar el cumplimiento de esta política en los procesos de reclutamiento, contratación, asignación, promoción, traslado, formación, compensación, beneficios, actividades laborales, acceso a instalaciones y programas, y en el trato general durante el empleo.

Adaptaciones razonables: Wright Service Corp. cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables sobre adaptaciones razonables para las personas, incluida la Ley de Estadounidenses con Discapacidades (ADA). En consecuencia, según lo exija la ley, ofreceremos adaptaciones razonables a los solicitantes y empleados que las soliciten o para quienes tengamos conocimiento de que las necesitan, independientemente de cualquier clasificación protegida, relacionadas con: (i) una discapacidad, entendida como una deficiencia física, médica, mental o psicológica, o el historial o registro de dicha deficiencia; (ii) creencias y prácticas religiosas sinceramente sostenidas; (iii) necesidades relacionadas con el embarazo, el parto o condiciones médicas asociadas; o (iv) cualquier otro motivo exigido por la ley aplicable, salvo que la adaptación suponga una carga indebida.
