title: Field Service Technician, SPD
description:
Join a team committed to advancing patient outcomes through adaptable healthcare solutions.

Skytron isn't just a place to work - it's a place to grow, collaborate, and help improve healthcare outcomes. As a family-owned company, we believe in supporting our people, driving innovation, and creating solutions that truly make a difference.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) starting on day one
  • Annual Bonus
  • Paid vacation, personal days, and holidays
  • 401(k) and profit sharing
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Employee wellness program
  • A supportive, family-owned work environment

What You'll Do

As a Field Service Technician, you will install, maintain, and repair Skytron sterile processing equipment at customer sites, ensuring reliable performance and outstanding service for our acute care partners. In this role, you will:

  • Install Skytron sterile processing equipment (sterilizers, ultrasonics, washers, and cart washers) according to manufacturer specifications
  • Inspect and test malfunctioning sterile processing equipment, using appropriate test and analysis instruments
  • Disassemble malfunctioning equipment, repairing or replacing defective components and electrical parts
  • Coordinate with site personnel and external contractors to verify project site readiness for equipment installations, including: facility utility requirements, product delivery, and safe movement of materials to the designated worksite
  • Maintain regular, timely communications with customers and key stakeholders regarding the status of installation projects, customer issues, and equipment issues
  • Perform remote service and diagnostics by phone, email, and video conferencing, to resolve external customer equipment issues; initiating escalation where appropriate
  • Maintain factory certification and proficiency on all servicing product lines
  • Generate revenue growth by offering solutions aligned with the service portfolio
  • Complete service-related administrative duties in a thorough and timely manner, including: service work orders, expense reports, preventative maintenance and installation documentation, site and service documentation, and other related paperwork
  • Travel up to 75 percent of the time

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone dependable, technically sharp, and comfortable working independently in the field. Success in this role requires strong communication, adaptability, and sound judgment under pressure. The ideal candidate will:

  • Capably handle required administrative functions
  • Verify work to ensure accurate results
  • Follow work instructions, procedures, safety guidelines, and company policies
  • Meet productivity standards, deadlines, and project schedules
  • Communicate effectively with various levels of employees and customers, both verbally and in writing
  • Be internally motivated and work well with minimal supervision
  • Be flexible in working hours, including mandatory overtime on short notice and/or weekends, as needed
  • Devise workable solutions or consult with secondary resources to devise solutions
  • Maintain a good driving record and valid driver's license
  • Be subject to background checks and credentialing

Qualifications

  • Have a HS Diploma or equivalent. An Associate's degree in fluid dynamics, electronics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience in an electronics-related field is strongly preferred
  • Have previous experience and demonstrated success executing projects with defined milestones
  • Be able to interpret schematics and site drawings, without assistance
  • Possess a working knowledge of hydraulic and AC/DC electrical systems, functions, and uses
  • Have previous mechanical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting experience
  • Understand and apply pneumatic, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical theory to install, diagnose, and repair SPD equipment
  • Possess 3-5 years of experience working in a sterile processing environment, combined with prior technical work-related experience (Strongly Preferred)
  • Possess 3-5 years of experience installing and/or repairing HVAC systems (Strongly Preferred)

If you need assistance with the application process or would like to request a paper application, please contact Skytron's Human Resources Department at 800.759.8766.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Skytron welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and hires based on skills, experience, and qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under the law.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Java, Resiliency Technology

description:
The Toronto Star is seeking a dynamic and versatile Multimedia Journalist to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to produce engaging video and audio content and elevate our storytelling. This role is at the forefront of the Star’s commitment to audience-first journalism.

As a Multimedia Journalist, you will collaborate with reporters, editors, producers, and the broader digital team to create content that informs, engages, and inspires our diverse audience. The ideal candidate will have a passion for journalism, thrive under tight deadlines, and be an exceptional script writer and communicator.

This role falls within the Journalist classification in the Star's Editorial Department. It is a Unifor Local 87M position, based in Toronto.

What you will do

  • Create short videos featuring Star journalists explaining their reporting.
  • Produce interview videos, explainers, and other multimedia content that enhances audience understanding of key stories.
  • Collaborate with reporters and editors to transform complex stories into compelling audio and video content for a variety of platforms (thestar.com, YouTube, TikTok, etc.).
  • Work on live and pre-recorded virtual events, including interviews and panel discussions.
  • Report news and conduct interviews on camera/microphone, both in studio and in the field.
  • Develop, script, and produce high-quality podcasts, including narrative series, news podcasts and video podcasts.
  • Guide non-technical team members in video and audio production, providing clear and patient communication.
  • Collaborate with editors and the digital team to identify audience needs and content opportunities.
  • Optimize content for distribution across platforms — including thestar.com, YouTube, TikTok, Apple Podcasts and podcast apps
  • Ensure audio and video content meets the Star’s journalistic standards.
  • Innovate and experiment with new formats and tools to continuously improve multimedia offerings.

Salary: $61,153.45 - $96,697.60

To apply, upload a single PDF in the resume field by 5 p.m. on Aug. 14, 2026, to our online portal containing:

  • Cover letter: Tell us why the Star needs you as a Multimedia Journalist
  • Resume
  • Link to demo reel or portfolio
  • Links to three examples of published multimedia journalism you’ve done

This is a notice of vacancy under Article 8 of collective agreement between Toronto Star Newspapers Limited and Unifor Local 87M. The hours of work for this position will vary according to the assignment but will all conform to a standard 35-hour work week as described under the collective agreement. This position will be in Toronto.

  • Experience creating multimedia content in major newsrooms.
  • Excellent interviewing skills and on camera/microphone presence.
  • Expertise in video and audio production, including scripting, recording, and editing.
  • Proficiency with industry-standard tools for video and audio production.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt complex topics for a variety of platforms (YouTube, TikTok, thestar.com, Apple podcasts, etc.) and understand how best to serve the audience on each platform.

Working on the roadway team at GFT offers the opportunity to engage in transformative projects that enhance transportation infrastructure and improve community connectivity. As a Project Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of roadway and highway projects across the Midwest. In this role, you’ll take ownership of design tasks, prepare plans and technical documentation, and support project management activities to meet our high standards for delivering projects on time, within scope, and in alignment with established quality expectations. You’ll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, mentor junior staff, and continue developing your technical expertise and client-facing skills within the transportation infrastructure sector.

In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

  • Establish working relationships and contact with client technical staff and project managers.

  • Project QA/QC.
  • Assist project managers with various other tasks.
  • Ability to multi-task and manage workload on various projects simultaneously.
  • Initiative to undertake tasks efficiently and independently.

What you will bring to our firm:
  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering from an ABET-accredited university.
  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in Kansas or Missouri; additional state licensure is a plus.
  • 8+ years of engineering experience with broad knowledge of transportation design and strong technical skills in highway design.
  • Experience with State DOT and/or local municipality/county design projects.

  • Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $125,000. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.

Featured Benefits:

  • Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations

At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power, and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. At S&ME, we have a history of delivering innovative geotechnical, civil, environmental, and construction material testing for over 50 years. About The Role:

As an entry-level Construction Materials Engineering Technician, you enjoy starting your day outdoors and take pride in hands-on work that impacts the projects you work on. Each day brings new challenges as you help ensure construction quality and safety while growing your technical skills. At S&ME, our Construction Materials Engineering Technicians are vital to ensuring construction projects meet quality and safety standards. From day one, you'll be in the field gaining hands-on experience and building a strong foundation for your career.

  • Start with the Basics: Begin with concrete sampling and testing, then expand into soils, asphalt, and masonry as you grow.
  • Earn While You Learn: Receive paid, on-the-job training and support for certifications through ACI and ICC.

  • Testing & Documentation: Perform field and lab tests, maintain equipment, and ensure accurate, complete reporting.
  • Inspections & Standards: Conduct inspections per IBC codes, document findings, and manage data using Metafield®.

Experience shifting weekly work hours based on project needs and weather conditions, including early mornings, late evenings, weekends, possible holidays, and overtime (paid at time and a half).

  • Routinely lifting and carrying 40-50lbs (field/laboratory samples and equipment)
  • Maneuvering field equipment safely, such as a loaded wheelbarrow, on uneven ground around active construction sites

Grow With Us:

S&ME provides a comprehensive benefits package to support you and your family, as well as career development resources. Come grow and thrive with us at S&ME!

  • Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) - with rollover options

  • Employee Recognition Program
  • Credential Incentive Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Company Vehicle with Fuel Card for Project-Based Work
  • $2,000 Referral Bonuses & More!

Join us at S&ME!

Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

Lambda, Inc. is seeking a highly skilled and experienced data center technician to join our Infrastructure deployment team. As a member of AI Infrastructure Deployments you will be the on-site face of Lambda to vendors and contractors for data center deployments. You will be responsible for completing deployments and improvements of Lambda's integrated data center solutions. You will collaborate with your teammates and cross-functional teams to pilot new technologies, physically deploy large AI/ML clusters, setup network configurations, and build out Lambda data center locations. Additionally, you will interface with Hardware Engineering and Supply Chain teams to comply with operational standards and requirements to improve deployment quality and speed.   • Be a primary deployment member for major cluster / data center deployments as well as be able to respond to smaller on-premise deployments, if needed.

  • Develop your skillset for new data center deployments, deployment planning, and technical AI infrastructure and cluster configurations.

  • Be responsive to project management, Supply Chain, HPC logical configuration, and Data Center Operations teams during deployment planning and execution.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address deployment-related challenges and optimize regional operations.

  • Interface with vendors to guide the build out of Lambda data center to meet exacting standards.

  • Understand power/cooling requirements as well as cabling needs required within data center space to support high performance infrastructures to guide data center build outs.

  • Participate in technical discussions and provide input on data center integration and deployment strategies.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Supply Chain, Customer Experience and Sales, to align data center solutions with business goals.

title: Software Engineer, Networking (Edge)
description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

Job Description

We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Utilize extensive network engineering knowledge coupled with software development and SRE/DevOps proficiency to design, construct, and oversee Tailscale’s global Funnel and DERP relay infrastructure.
  • Promote operational excellence and automation to guarantee the scalability, high availability, and performance of hosted services.
  • Offer architectural guidance and troubleshoot escalated networking problems for customers to address intricate connectivity issues.
  • Partner with internal engineering and product groups to advance hosted services and clients, ensuring updates provide broad value to our customer base.
  • Support network connectivity capabilities and features by contributing to the open-source client code and developing the Tailscale product dataplane.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, construct, evaluate, and provide documentation for networking features, connectivity solutions, and the open-source client-code network dataplane.
  • Enhance and iterate on product capabilities, specifically focusing on Funnel and DERP relay infrastructures and their associated network protocols.
  • Investigate and rectify complex, escalated network difficulties encountered across diverse technical environments.
  • Maintain accountability for Tailscale's live services by integrating observability, engaging in incident management, and managing technical support escalations.
  • Evaluate and boost the performance, reliability, and scaling capabilities of our networking resources and systems.
  • Apply a security-centric approach to every stage of development, from initial design to final implementation of networking components.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven track record in networking software development and troubleshooting
  • Expertise in core networking principles such as VPNs, NAT traversal, routing, and IP addressing
  • Experience with distributed systems, maintaining global-scale services, and applying SRE & DevOps methodologies
  • Most of the systems are developed in the Go programming language. Experience with Go is highly desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for exchanging constructive feedback and the autonomy to work solo
  • Adaptability to thrive within a fast-paced startup environment
  • Superior communication abilities, both in writing and speaking

$218,420—$273,360 CAD

title: Semi Mfg Technician 2 (ASSM - S5)
description:

Working in a state-of-the-art cleanroom environment, you'll utilize your precision skills to manually attach Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), perform wire bonding, and inspect devices for quality assurance. Your keen eye for detail will ensure every product meets our high standards, while your ability to communicate effectively with management and engineers will help address any unexpected results swiftly. Collaborating closely with your colleagues, you’ll help drive efficiency in our processes and maintain safety and cleanliness standards. This role not only requires technical expertise but also offers an opportunity to be part of a groundbreaking team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. Join us and make a significant impact in the world of optoelectronics!


For shift 5, 6:00PM - 6:00AM, Monday - Wednesday and every other Thursday.

  • Process and assemble optoelectronic devices in a cleanroom environment, ensuring high standards of quality.
  • Perform meticulous inspections on devices using microscopes to identify and address processing defects.
  • Execute manual die attachment of Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) and surface-mounted devices with precision.
  • Utilize semi-automated tools for wire bonding, ensuring consistent and reliable connections.
  • Accurately enter and manage data in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for tracking and reporting purposes.
  • Communicate effectively with team members regarding tool and lot status for seamless shift transitions.
  • Adhere strictly to Fab safety and cleanliness protocols to maintain a compliant working environment.
  • Proactively inform management and engineers of any unexpected results to facilitate immediate resolutions.

You have:

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Basic computer skills for email, spreadsheets, and data entry.

It would be nice if you also had:

  • Experience with wire bonding and surface-mounted device assembly.
  • Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
  • Strong attention to detail for inspecting workmanship.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with team members and management.

title: Technical Instructor
description:
SOSi is seeking a Technical Instructor to support mission requirements for a structured approach to further develop, integrate, and sustain a scalable, federated data ecosystem that enhances interoperability, governance, and mission-driven analytics for a DoD customer. The primary objective of the program is to bridge the operational gaps between DoD, IC, interagency, and non-traditional international partners to enable real-time information sharing, dynamic data integration, and mission-tailored analytical capabilities.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Responsible for developing and delivering advanced instruction to an expanded title authority program training audience such as title 10/50 Military Intelligence Program (MIP) and in areas such as:
    • ESRI Software and Geospatial Data Analysis
    • API-based data integration and request workflows
    • Jupyter Notebook-based data engineering and geospatial data layer creation
    • Metadata tagging, data stewardship, and catalog integration
    • OSINT analysis techniques and structured reporting workflows
  • Coordinates closely with the Training Coordinator to align technical content with approved training events and mission objectives.
  • Develop and maintain a training data tracking and reporting capability, under the direction of the Government, to support program performance visibility and strategic planning.
  • Provide dashboard inputs summarizing this data for Government approval on a bi-weekly basis (aligned with sprint reporting) and shall update the dashboard within 5 business days following the conclusion of each training event.
  • Document the planning, delivery, and evaluation of each training program purchased, including travel coordination, curriculum verification, and on-site logistics. A post-execution summary report shall be submitted within 10 business days of event completion.
  • Coordinate country clearances, travel arrangements, and liaison activities with sponsoring Commands, U.S. embassies, and partner nation representatives.
  • Facilitate graduation ceremonies, ensuring proper documentation of participant completion and skill mastery.
  • Implement post-training assessments and evaluations, gathering participant feedback and performance metrics to refine future training iterations.
  • Provide a comprehensive training impact report, detailing the effectiveness of knowledge transfer, skill adoption rates, and recommendations for program enhancement.
  • Administer post-training language satisfaction surveys to partner nation trainees, collecting quantitative and qualitative feedback on language accessibility, translation accuracy, and instructor communication.
  • Compile and analyze feedback data quarterly, identifying trends, deficiencies, and areas for improvement in multilingual training delivery.
  • Provide an annual report summarizing language feedback insights, corrective actions taken, and recommendations for improving multilingual training effectiveness.
  • Host remote training materials, provide access to self-paced learning modules, and facilitate sessions.
  • Track participant engagement in remote training materials.
  • Provide a quarterly report on remote training participation, knowledge retention rates, and areas requiring further improvement.

Minimum Requirements

  • Active TS/SCI Clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, Intelligence Studies, Data Science, or a related field, or;
    • a minimum of five (5) years of equivalent experience in technical training, curriculum development, or applied instruction.
  • Expert-level knowledge in data engineering, geospatial analysis, and open-source intelligence (OSINT) methodologies.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing and delivering training on the use of Jupyter Notebooks, API integrations, metadata management, and structured data layer development.
  • Familiarity with secure data environments, role-based access controls (RBAC), and cataloging standards is essential.
  • Skilled in creating and adapting hands-on instructional content for technical users, including practical exercises that simulate real-world data processing, analysis, and visualization tasks.
  • Ability to coordinate with the Training Coordinator to align delivery with broader training objectives and ensure content is responsive to Government-directed priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to facilitate documentation, post-training support, and dynamic engagement with both U.S. and partner nation personnel.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of OSINT methodologies, geospatial data analysis, or intelligence tradecraft, with practical exposure to ESRI ArcGIS, dashboard analytics, Jupyter Notebooks, or other mission-relevant tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting interagency collaboration, training program evaluation, or working with international or partner-nation personnel is desirable but not required for baseline qualification.
  • The position is suited for junior to mid-level professionals with strong instructional delivery skills and the ability to develop practical, scenario-based technical content.

Work Environment

  • Normal office conditions.

Working at SOSi

All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.

title: Feather Process Operator
description:
Company Details

Darling Ingredients repurposes and recycles materials from the animal agriculture and food industries - transforming them into essential ingredients that do everything from feeding animals to fertilizing crops to fueling planes and nourishing people. We're the number one publicly traded company of our kind, operating a global family of brands and businesses that span more than 260 facilities in over 15 countries. Our unique scale allows us to make entire industries less wasteful and more sustainable, helping move the world toward a more circular economy.

Darling Ingredients offers full time employees a full suite of benefits including but not limited to the following: 401(k), Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, and Paid Time Off.


Job Summary

Feather Operator is responsible for the operation of the computer-controlled process equipment, cooker, machinery, and evaluation of any process problems in addition to performing product quality testing.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

  • Control flow of material to presses and to finished goods storage.
  • Monitor control panel and various gauges to accomplish process.
  • Operate pollution control system including air/odor control system and wastewater control.
  • Perform periodic preventative maintenance on all equipment in process.
  • Monitor machinery; bring all problems to attention of manager.

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • One year of Manufacturing, industrial, or agricultural experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of mechanical rendering process preferred.

  • Basic math skills; ability to compute decimals and percentages.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • Good oral and written skills.
  • Ability to deal with minor problems involving equipment or various situations.
  • Ability to work nights and/or weekends as needed.

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. title: Program Manager Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Marketing team helps translate complex technology, research, and product moments into work that can be understood by audiences around the world. The team brings together creative direction, design, writing, production, strategy, marketing, and regional partners to deliver campaigns, launches, films, events, brand systems, social, digital, OOH, experiential, and emerging formats across global markets.

This role sits close to creative, production, Brand Marketing, Resource Management, agencies, and cross-functional partners. It is designed for someone who can turn approved strategic direction into a clear program path and keep that path moving—from goals and operating model through creative development, production, launch readiness, and closeout.

The role will work closely with Resource Managers to anticipate resource needs, maintain accurate allocations, and identify gaps early enough to address them before they become delivery risks.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a Program Manager Lead to own end-to-end program execution for the Hardware team once strategy and scope are set. This role will partner closely with Brand Marketing on goals, roadmaps, operating models, and launch priorities, translating that direction into actionable plans, workstreams, ownership, cadences, resource plans, risk management, and execution.

You will provide the operating spine for complex creative programs, creating clarity across goals, roadmaps, owners, decisions, dependencies, resources, risks, and next steps. You will ensure approved initiatives have a coherent operating model, realistic resourcing, visible risks, and disciplined follow-through from kickoff through completion.

The ideal candidate combines deep program ownership with calm judgment, crisp communication, and respect for creative craft. You can turn ambiguity into practical operating plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable with tact, anticipate risks and resource conflicts, and build lightweight systems that help teams produce better work faster.

In this role, you will:

  • Own end-to-end program execution for integrated Hardware marketing initiatives across campaigns, launches, brand, content, social, digital, experiential, OOH, growth, and e-commerce.

  • Partner with Brand Marketing to translate approved strategy, GTM priorities, and success measures into clear program roadmaps with milestones, ownership, dependencies, and escalation paths.

  • Build and maintain the program plans, workbacks, operating models, and tracking systems that give teams clear visibility into priorities, progress, resources, risks, and decisions.

  • Lead the program operating rhythm across kickoffs, status updates, creative reviews, leadership forums, and follow-through, ensuring decisions are made, documented, and translated into action.

  • Partner with creative and production leads to protect the creative process while keeping development, reviews, production requirements, budgets, and delivery milestones connected to the broader program plan.

  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across marketing, creative, production, agencies, legal, policy, media, regional teams, and other partners, keeping dependencies, approvals, and handoffs on track.

  • Partner with Creative Operations and Resource Management to forecast capacity and resource needs, maintain accurate allocation views, and address gaps before they become delivery risks.

  • Anticipate and surface blockers, resource constraints, timeline pressure, budget implications, and dependency conflicts early, escalating with clear options and recommendations when needed.

  • Maintain horizontal visibility across active work so teams and leadership have a clear view of program health, priorities, risks, decisions, resources, and next steps.

  • Own launch readiness, ensuring critical creative, production, localization, review, and stakeholder dependencies are aligned and on track for delivery.

  • Drive program closeout, capturing outcomes, open actions, learnings, and process improvements that strengthen future programs.

  • Build lightweight, scalable ways of working that improve visibility, prioritization, resourcing, and delivery without adding unnecessary process.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in program management, creative operations, agency operations, marketing operations, production-adjacent program management, or integrated creative delivery.

  • Have managed complex creative or marketing programs spanning campaigns, launches, content, social, digital, experiential, OOH, or brand work.

  • Understand how strategic work moves from goals and planning through creative development, production, and launch—and where complex programs typically get stuck.

  • Are highly organized and can turn ambiguity into a practical program roadmap without overcomplicating the process.

  • Communicate clearly and diplomatically with senior creatives, marketers, producers, agencies, legal partners, regional teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Are comfortable creating accountability across teams with tact, precision, and momentum.

  • Have strong instincts for operating cadence, decision-making, resource planning, status reporting, action follow-through, and risk escalation.

  • Can distinguish between marketing strategy, creative judgment, production craft, resource management, and program management ownership.

  • Bring enough budget and resourcing fluency to understand scopes, SOWs, POs, agency fees, production dependencies, capacity constraints, staffing gaps, and delivery tradeoffs.

  • Are fluent in the tools creative teams use to work, including Google Workspace, Slack, Figma, Airtable, Monday.com, Asana, or similar project and resource management systems.

  • Operate with strong discretion around sensitive launches, staffing, budgets, campaign strategy, partner details, and leadership priorities.

  • Have genuine interest in technology, creative craft, international marketing, and the transformative potential of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Operations Associate
description:
Operations Associate

Company Description

Sagetap is a rapidly growing startup changing how enterprise technology executives discover and evaluate software. Our AI-driven platform anonymously connects tech buyers with the industry's most credible technology vendors, helping them cut through the noise and solve their biggest problems.

Backed by investors like NFX Ventures, Uncorrelated Ventures, and Emergent Ventures, we are on a mission to fundamentally change software discovery for senior technology leaders, fostering meaningful connections in a non-sales setting.

We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team that values curiosity, transparency, and impact. If you're energetic, results-oriented, and excited to work in an early-stage environment, come help us shape the future of technology buying at Sagetap!

Job Description

As Sagetap's Operations Associate, you'll be the first hire into a brand-new Operations function, reporting directly to our leadership team. You'll own the execution layer across people operations, hiring, compliance, IT/equipment, legal administration, and culture.

We're a small team, so nothing here is theoretical. In your first six months you'll run onboarding for several new hires, coordinate a company on-site, help stand up our SOC 2 program, and build the systems that let a 20-person company operate like a much larger one. Partnering directly with the leadership team, you'll develop an understanding of how the whole business fits together.

This is a hands-on, detail-heavy role. Much of the work is coordination, paperwork, and follow-through, and we're looking for someone who takes real pride in that craft. At our size, reliable execution is what keeps the company running. Where you see a better way to do something, we want to hear it; good ideas get adopted here on their merits.

What you will do

  • Manage vendors, insurance, and recurring obligations. Maintain vendor documentation (W-9s, COIs, security questionnaires), run insurance renewals with our broker, and track every renewal, filing, and notice to on-time completion.

  • Keep contracts moving and organized. Sending, tracking and filing agreements out for signature and chase them until they're executed. Track expiration and renewal dates so nothing lapses or auto-renews by surprise.

  • Own equipment and the SaaS stack. Procure, ship, track, and recover laptops across a distributed team, and maintain the inventory of licenses, seats, and spend.

  • Handle day-to-day people operations. Run onboarding and offboarding, administer HR (benefits, PTO, leave, training) in Justworks, coordinate all recruiting, and keep the performance review cycle on track.

  • Support our SOC 2 Type 2 program. Collect control evidence in Drata, run access reviews, execute company-wide security awareness training, and maintain the compliance and vendor documentation trail.

  • Run engagement and company events. Book venues, travel, and logistics for on-sites, all-hands, and offsites, and handle recognition (birthdays, anniversaries, milestones), swag, and engagement surveys.

  • Close the loop on action items. Capture commitments from recurring company meetings and follow up until they close, write SOPs, and prepare data for business reviews and all-hands.

  • Pick up the work that doesn't have an owner yet. This is a brand-new function, so new problems tend to land here first. Part of the job is deciding what becomes a real process and what stays a one-off.

Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of experience in business operations, people operations, HR operations, chief-of-staff support, or a similar generalist role, ideally at a startup where you wore several hats

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through. You track your own commitments, and things don't get dropped

  • Strong written communication. You can write a clear SOP, a clean announcement, and a direct status update

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action. You'd rather draft a first version and iterate than wait for a spec

  • Fluency with modern work tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Linear or similar) and genuine eagerness to use AI to move faster

  • Sound judgment with sensitive and confidential information

Nice to have

  • Experience with some of our tech stack: Justworks (or similar HRIS), Drata, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Linear

  • Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or another compliance framework

  • Recruiting coordination or ATS experience

What we are looking for

  • Ownership. You treat the things you're handed as yours, and you close the loop without being asked twice.

  • Systems thinking. You notice when you've done something manually three times and turn it into a process.

  • Low ego, high standards. No task is beneath you, and none of them get done sloppily.

  • Discretion and trust. You'll handle compensation, personnel, and legal information from week one.

  • Curiosity about the business. You want to understand why the work matters, not just complete it.

What you will have at Sagetap

  • Compensation: $85,000 - $110,000 base salary, depending on experience

  • Early-stage equity

  • 401(k) and comprehensive healthcare benefits

  • Direct access to company leadership and visibility across every function

  • Real ownership in building a category-defining product

  • Opportunity to work closely with a high-performing, mission-driven team

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed. We work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

EDUCATION

Required

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Collaborates with interprofessional team members to provide clinical expertise and leadership in cognitive behavioral therapy and psychological assessment of all patients.

  • Positively impacts quality and cost outcomes by assuring optimal behavioral & psychological evaluations &/or treatment to minimize potential complications potential complications to the program.
  • Completes activity / productivity & other reports as needed.

GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Serves as a leader in curriculum & program development for behavioral component for assigned population programs and participates in marketing and community outreach to promote assigned population.
  • Keeps up to date on cognitive behavior therapy initiatives and current trends in the behavioral treatment in area of specialty. Completes and updates the individual development plan (IDP) on an on-going basis.

title: Payments Counsel
description:
About the Company

Rain makes the next generation of payments possible across the globe. We’re a lean and mighty team of passionate builders and veteran founders. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real-world by powering card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company that is funded by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS, including Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Lightspeed, Khosla, and several more. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we’d love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

We’re looking for a Payments Counsel to join our growing Legal team. You’ll be a trusted advisor across the business, ensuring our products, licenses, and partnerships are structured and executed in compliance with applicable payments regulations. This is a highly cross-functional role, working closely with Compliance, Risk, Product, and Business Development.

What you’ll do

  • Advise on U.S. and EU payments regulations, including state money transmission laws, federal banking regulations, PSD2/PSD3, EMD2, e-money licensing, card network rules, and virtual asset frameworks.

  • Partner with Compliance and Licensing teams on MTL applications, international licenses, and ongoing obligations.

  • Draft card holder agreements across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements with banks, payment processors, card networks, and vendors.

  • Manage relationships with outside counsel on specialized regulatory or jurisdictional issues.

  • Assist with responses to regulators and participate in audits, exams, and inquiries.

  • Stay ahead of regulatory changes affecting payments, crypto, and fintech; help shape internal strategy and external engagement.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • A JD from a top-level law program. Preference for US-trained lawyers, but international JDs will be considered.

  • At least 5–8 years of legal experience, focused on payments, fintech, financial services regulation, or related areas.

  • Strong understanding of US and EU payments regulations, including state MTLs, the Durbin Amendment, Regulation E, PSD2/PSD3, EMD2, EMI licensing, and card network rules.

  • Experience advising on commercial contracts and regulatory issues for fintech or payments companies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex regulation into clear business advice.

  • A collaborative, business-oriented mindset; comfortable working across multiple teams and time zones.

Bonus attributes:

  • Digital assets/crypto regulatory experience (e.g., VASP regimes, MiCA).

  • Prior in-house experience at a fintech, payments company, or financial regulator.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

  • Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

  • Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace, if you feel comfortable at home please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will have a stipend to create a comfortable atmosphere at home.

  • Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

  • Retirement goals 💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

  • Equity plan 📦 We offer every Rainmaker an equity option plan so we can all benefit from our success.

  • Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture — whatever recharges you!

  • Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain! Time spent together helps us get to know each other, strengthen our relationships, and build a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites both domestically and internationally.

description:

These internships will be paid and run from November to February across a 10-week period.

Working within our global R&D teams, you'll be provided an opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to a variety of engineering projects focused on developing the next generation of sorting, inspection, sensing and automation technologies. These projects span everything from advanced machine vision and fruit inspection systems through to new sorting platforms, product reliability improvements, prototype development and research-based testing programmes.

Here's a sneak peek into what you could be doing:

  • Concept generation, engineering analysis and product development activities
  • Designing mechanical components and assemblies using 3D CAD software
  • Creating engineering drawings, manufacturing documentation and work instructions
  • Building proof-of-concept prototypes, including mechanical, electronic and software-integrated systems
  • Supporting the assembly and integration of prototype equipment
  • Conducting testing, validation and performance evaluations on new technologies and products
  • Collecting, analysing and interpreting engineering data to support design decisions
  • Investigating opportunities to improve product performance, reliability and manufacturability
  • Evaluating new materials, components and engineering concepts
  • Supporting research projects aimed at improving how fresh produce is inspected, handled and sorted
  • Conducting risk assessments and supporting safe engineering practices
  • Working alongside engineers to implement design improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Updating technical documentation and project records

This is a hands-on role that requires technical skills which could include experience with SolidWorkS / 3D CAD, rapid prototyping, product design, and designing & implementing test protocols. The core strengths we are looking for are mechanical aptitude, problem solving, an analytical mind, great communication skills and basic workshop skills.

Deadline to submit an application is Sunday, August 16th, 2026!

You could be a great fit if you are currently studying Mechanical, Mechatronics, or a related discipline and have an interest in product development, design, prototyping and testing.

To apply, you'll need to:

  • Be available to participate in our full-time, 10-week internship programme running between November 2026 and February 2027
  • Be able to work onsite five days per week from our R&D facility in Auckland, NZ

description:

The Employment Readiness Specialist will deliver services to individuals in the Employment Readiness Program, supporting them to grow essential workplace skills.   • Seek feedback from participants and their support team regarding pre-employment transition services provided to learn satisfaction and to update curriculum topics and activities. Attain positive satisfaction ratings on feedback surveys.

  • Collect, complete, and maintain required documentation, which may include billing reports, participant reports, and case notes, etc.

  • Maintain case files and records to CARF standards. This includes completing and renewing annual releases, individual employment/service plans, and updating participant’s physical and electronic files.

  • Required: High school diploma or General Educational Development (GED).

  • Required: Valid driver’s license and/or access to reliable transportation to perform work-related travel. Must be eligible to be covered under the ServiceSource driver’s insurance. Must pass the online driving training, if eligible to drive.
  • Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Education, Marketing, or another related field.
  • Preferred: Experience providing supported employment services.
  • Preferred: Experience conducting training.
  • Preferred: Experience building partnerships with community organizations and employers.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • An energetic, compassionate, organized self-starter, and team player who can relate to people at all levels.
  • Public speaking and training skills, with the ability to follow a curriculum, customize activities, and train and teach in a group setting in an engaging and informative manner.

  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret complex documents.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, Internet, and email navigation with the ability to teach these skills to participants.

Work Environment

The employee may be visiting a variety of worksites and may occasionally be exposed to outside weather conditions.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Administers all contract management processes, including coordination with relevant protocol, informed consent, institution, investigator, vendor, consultant, and customer agreement documents at a project level.
  • May lead (with supervision) multi-country projects including negotiating and preparing contracts, budgets, and related documents for participation in industry-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Provides support to SSUL to agree on country template contract and budget. Produces site-specific contracts from country template. Provide support in submissions for proposed contract and budget for site.
  • Provides support in negotiating budget and contract with site via Site Contracts Service Centre and SSUL with Sponsor until resolution of issues.
  • Performs quality control and arranges execution of CTAs as well as archival of documents into repositories and capture of metadata.
  • Reviews contracts for completeness and accuracy, and ensures that corrections are appropriately made and documented.
  • Provides supports to business development and represents site contracts/Site Start-Up (SSU) at internal or customer meetings.
  • Work with Contract Managers and team members with the active project management of ongoing contract issues; performs follow-up on all outstanding contract issues.
  • Supports in generating amended contract and/or budget documents as necessary, preparing contract management documentation for projects, and streamlining the contract/proposal or internal processes; and initiates and introduces creative ideas and solutions.
  • Works within the forecasted country/site contracting timelines, ensures they are complied with and tracks milestone progress in agreed upon SSU tracking system in real time.
  • Collaborates with internal and external legal, finance, and clinical operations departments, including communicating and explaining legal and budgetary issues.
  • Facilitates the execution of contracts by company signatories.
  • Maintains contract templates and site specific files and databases.
  • Trains and mentors less experienced staff members on departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensures quality of team work products. Maintains and updates training material for site contract team.
  • Acts asa communication liaison between site contracts staff and internal and external customers. Provides functional guidance and keeps internal and external teams aware of all contract statuses or pending issues. Prepares correspondence as necessary.
  • Monitors basic financial aspects of the project and the number of hours/tasks available per contract; escalates discrepancies in a timely fashion.
  • Reviews and complies with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) in a timely manner, keeps training records updated accordingly and ensures timesheet compliance.

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Health, related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • High level of contracts management experience.
  • Experience in a contract research organization or pharmaceutical industry essential.
  • Strong knowledge of the clinical development process and legal and contracting parameters.
  • Strong computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Customer focused and ability to manage challenging priorities and to remain flexible and adaptable in stressful situations.
  • Excellent understanding of clinical trial process across Phases II-IV and ICH GCP.
  • Good understanding clinical protocols and associated study specifications.
  • Excellent understanding of clinical trial start-up processes.
  • Project management experience in a fast-paced environment.

• Good vendor management skills.

  • Excellent written/oral communication in French and English, presentation, documentation, interpersonal skills as well as strong team-orientation.
  • Strong organizational skills with proven ability to handle multiple projects excellent communication.
  • Quality-driven in all managed activities. Strong negotiating skills. Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to mentor, lead and motivate more junior staff.
  • Demonstrate an ability to provide quality feedback and guidance to peers Contribute to a training and Quality assurance plan within SSU and update SOPs/WI.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

title: Team Lead
description:
Tecovas is passionate about offering an incredible customer experience for first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike! We’re looking for a talented Part-Time Team Lead that will contribute to a profitable and customer-centric environment through the development of a team and management of our total store operations. You will support product flow and apply merchant and customer service skills to curate a compelling in-store experience.

Responsibilities will include:

LEADERSHIP & TEAM MANAGEMENT

  • Supports the Store Manager in recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent
  • Supports the Store Manager in creating and maintaining a succession strategy
  • Foster a culture of strong communication and teamwork in order to ensure a seamless balance between operational, visual and customer priorities.
  • Administers performance appraisals, sets goals and conducts consistent touch-bases with direct reports.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

  • Cultivates an environment of genuine customer connection
  • Demonstrates extraordinary service and acts as a brand ambassador reflective of the company values
  • Facilitates an energized pace, positive service environment and team development
  • Delivers high-quality product services with attention to detail - such as branding, debossing, boot stretching, brim shaping, and boot shines - to ensure a premium customer experience
  • Understands an OMNI Channel business - implements processes and utilizes tools to better service the customer

VISUAL AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS

  • Facilitates the sharing of product knowledge
  • Upholds stock-to-sales processes, presentation standards, and manages product placement
  • Maintains an effective store structure, floor plan, and appropriate fixture usage
  • Upholds and ensures compliance with shipments, transfers and restock standards
  • Adheres to and develops awareness around internal and external Loss Prevention procedures

COMMUNICATION AND RELATIONSHIPS

  • Set clear objectives and expectations to drive a consistent store experience and ensure excellent operational and visual standards
  • Encourage and demonstrate adaptability; positively effecting change and enabling the team to successfully execute a shared vision

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years Retail Management experience
  • Must be available to work 15-20 hours per week
  • Exceptional leadership, selling, and customer service skills
  • Strong merchant skills and a history of delivering financial results
  • Proven record of hiring and developing great talent
  • Experienced in coaching, counseling & conflict resolution
  • Independent, proactive, results-driven work ethic
  • Utmost character, honesty, and transparency

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma required (College Degree preferred)
  • Must be at least 18 years of age or older
  • Continually able to stand/walk for extended periods of time, and be able to reach overhead, bend, squat, and kneel as you organize and stock inventory.
  • Ability to deliver excellent customer service while implementing loss prevention practices
  • Able to lift up to 30lbs regularly and perform store maintenance tasks
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Must be available to work weekends (Friday, Saturday and Sunday), evenings and holidays as needed

Part-Time Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly compensation + incentives
  • Free boots and generous employee discount

The hourly rate for this position is $18- $20. The actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.

About Us:

Tecovas was born out of a love for cowboy boots, their time-honored craftsmanship, rich materials that last, and traditional styling that always looks good. Each pair of Tecovas boots is crafted by hand in over 200 steps. It’s not the easiest or cheapest method, but we’re committed to classic construction techniques that stand the test of time. With 42 retail stores (and counting) across the country, we’re bringing western goods into new frontiers and aim to be the most welcoming brand in western. We’re certainly growing- and hiring passionate, humble, positive, and talented people determined to help us continue to grow!

Important note: We strive to hire values-aligned people because we believe it takes each and all of us to be successful, and lead with grit, speed and a clear vision of where we’re headed. In a remote setting, interviewing at Tecovas may include phone interviews, virtual “on-site” interviews, and on-the-job mock cases. We are committed to run a thorough process for candidates with whom we identify a potential match, and we will do our best to follow-up with each and every applicant! If you’re on the fence, just give it a try!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply! Information collected during the application process is subject to our privacy policy. Please note: Offers of employment may be conditional pending the completion of standard onboarding procedures.

title: Senior Impartner Admin, PRM
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior, Impartner Administrator, Partner Relationship Management

About the job

This position is needed to maintain, optimize, and scale extraordinary partner portal infrastructure for our rapidly growing Global Partnerships teams. The Partner Support team is essential for the success and scalability of our partner and indirect sales channels. We are the system heart of the organization, driving the platform configurations, integrations, and data hygiene that unlock new possibilities across Channel Sales, Alliances, and Partner Marketing.

This Senior Impartner Platform Administrator will serve as the technical owner of our partner ecosystem tech stack. With a strong focus on advanced Impartner PRM configuration and robust Salesforce CRM integration, you will execute our technical roadmap to deliver frictionless user experiences for our global partners. This role is a perfect match for a technical platform administrator who thrives on deep system architecture, automated workflows, and high-impact "Keep the Lights On" (KTLO) system maintenance.

The ideal candidate has a passion for building robust integrations, possesses an eye for system data integrity, and is constantly seeking ways to simplify complex admin configurations behind the scenes.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own Platform Administration: Manage day-to-day technical operations of the Impartner PRM platform, including access controls, page layouts, content management, and localized portal branding.
  • Maintain the CRM Sync: Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot the critical data sync between Impartner and Salesforce.com, ensuring leads, accounts, and custom deal registration data flow accurately across both systems.
  • Build Automated Workflows: Develop code-free automated partner lifecycles utilizing Impartner’s Journey Builder, setting up milestone alerts, automated tier progressions, and customized onboarding tracks.
  • Support Channel Enablement: Architect and maintain partner competency programs, training modules, and certification pathways within the portal to keep our global partners enabled.
  • Manage Lead & Deal Flow: Oversee the mechanics of lead distribution algorithms, deal registration routing, and Market Development Funds (MDF) application/claim workflows.
  • Enforce Platform Governance: Audit system logs, data health, and security rules. Ensure compliance with corporate data protection standards and platform updates across both Impartner and Salesforce environments.
  • Drive UAT and Testing: Conduct technical vetting, build out testing protocols in sandbox environments, and execute error-free production deployments for new tool integrations or module releases.

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. We value technical expertise gained from a variety of backgrounds and encourage anyone who meets the required core certifications and experience targets to apply.

Required:

  • 5+ Years of Dedicated PRM Admin Experience: At least 5 years of direct experience administering an enterprise Partner Relationship Management tool, with a deep mastery of the Impartner PRM platform. Certification: Impartner Certified Administrator
  • Compulsory Salesforce Certification: Must hold a current Salesforce Certified Administrator credential (Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder is highly desired).
  • Impartner Platform Credentials: Active participation in/completion of Impartner’s technical training and product administrator alignment programs (such as Impartner Certified Administrator pathways).
  • Technical Integration Skills: A proven track record managing complex API syncs, mapping custom fields between PRMs and Salesforce, and resolving sync log exceptions.
  • Problem Solving & Analytics: Strong experience building advanced operational dashboards, custom reports, and auditing data integrity across integrated systems.
  • Stakeholder Execution: Demonstrated success managing project timelines, organizing technical backlogs, and translating GTM business logic into solid system configurations.

Desired:

  • Advanced Toolkit: Experience utilizing backlog and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence to manage configuration requests.
  • Developer Familiarity: Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for portal layout styling or specialized workflow scripts is a plus.
  • Other Systems: experience with Cloud Coach and Professional Services workflow is a plus
  • Global Support Experience: Experience managing multi-currency, localized, or multi-lingual partner portals for a global channel ecosystem.

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • $99,760 - $124,700
  • Target Bonus Percentage 12.5%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: RN Telemetry Pulmonary
description:
Where You’ll Work

Founded in 1926, Dignity Health - Glendale Memorial Hospital and Health Center is a 334-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital. Serving over 70,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level III NICU, heart care, wound care and surgical services. Additionally, Glendale Memorial Hospital has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality High Performer by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Joint Commission-certified Thrombectomy-Capable Stroke Center and a SRC Center of Excellence for Robotic Surgery and Colorectal Surgery.

One Community. One Mission. One California

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Registered Nurse (RN), you will be a pivotal healthcare professional, delivering compassionate, high-quality care that truly impacts our patients' well-being and recovery.Every day, you will leverage your expertise to provide individualized, comprehensive care, making critical assessments, performing skilled procedures, and meticulously implementing patient care plans. You'll collaborate seamlessly within an interdisciplinary team, contributing to a dynamic environment focused on optimal patient outcomes.To thrive in this vital role, you will possess keen assessment skills, acute critical thinking, and a patient-first mindset, driven by a profound enthusiasm to help others. Your sense of urgency and dedication to excellence in a fast-paced environment will not only support patient recovery but also fuel your own career advancement.

  • Provides effective,comprehensive evidence based nursing care to achieve desired health outcomes. Organizes and prioritizes patient care activities balanced with the needs and comfort of the patient. Collaborates with other disciplines to insure comprehensive, holistic and effective plan of care. Applies knowledge of current practice standards, guidelines, statutes, rules and regulations. Demonstrates accountability for own ethical behavior and supports ethical practice by addressing or escalating issues. Serves as a patient advocate.
  • Completes patient assessments competently. Assesses for and identifies needs of unit-specific patient population: Assesses for and identifies any physical, emotional, psychosocial, spiritual, educational, discharge and cultural needs.
  • Completes an individualized plan of care based on assessment of the patient. Coordinates with other disciplines when indicated. Prioritizes care needs and sets measurable goals and time frames. Includes patient and family in the planning.
  • Implements interventions based on nursing and medical plan of care. Manages patient population, diagnosis and age specific needs through appropriate adaptation of interventions. Appropriately utilizes equipment and supplies (including following established policies, procedures and protocols governing the transport, handling and storage of intravenous fluids).
  • After implementation, reassesses the patient to verify effectiveness of interventions. Updates the plan of care to reflect current care needs.
We are not currently accepting new graduate or new to speciality applications. The most current information for new graduate (<12 months experience as an RN) and fellowship programs (>12 months experience as an RN) can be found at National Nurse Residency Program .

Position is represented by CNA

Job Requirements

Required

  • Requires minimum of 6 months previous acute care RN experience
  • Current and Active CA Registered Nurse
  • AHA Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)

Preferred

  • Bachelors Of Nursing, upon hire

title: Bakery/Deli Clerk
description:

· Bakery/Deli Clerk should offer product samples to help customers discover new items or products they inquire about.

· Reinforce safety programs by complying with safety procedures and identify unsafe conditions and notify store management.

· Notify management of customer or employee accidents.

· Ability to work cooperatively in high paced and sometimes stressful environment.

· Ability to manage conflict in a reasonable, nonconfrontational and cooperative manner.

· Ability to act with honesty and integrity regarding customer and business information.

· Ability to follow directions and seek assistance when necessary to resolve customer and business issues.

· Provide support and assistance through direct interaction with minors, individuals with special needs, and older adults.

· Must be able to perform the essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Customer Service skills
  • Effective communication skills
  • Knowledge of basic math
  • Ability to obtain current food handlers permit once employed
Desired Previous Job Experience:
  • Customer Service skills
  • Bakery or Deli experience is helpful
  • Retail experience

title: Sr. Director Field Technology Office and Advisory, Senior Director
description:
Our Mission

title: Molecular Biologist for the development of cancer diagnostics (Research Assistant)
description:
Department of Biology, Faculty of Science at University of Copenhagen is offering a position in molecular biology for a research assistant, developing circular DNA as a biomarker in cancer.

The position is available from 15 October or as soon as possible thereafter.

Extrachromosomal DNA circles are known from tumors where they carry proto-oncogenes and can induce tumorigenesis (DOI: 10.1016/j.tig.2022.02.007). Our recent data reveal that circular DNA is also found in blood plasma as circular circulating tumor DNA (circular ctDNA), suggesting that this new type of ctDNA can be an efficient marker for cancer. We have developed a technology for detecting circular ctDNA as a biomarker in plasma, and we are now looking for a scientific assistant to optimize and validate the method for robust, reproducible use by end users in hospital settings. This includes considering how the technology can be introduced into clinical workflows and how the existing solution can be automated for routine use. The successful candidate will work with the aim of advancing the technology toward commercialization, in close collaboration with the startup company CARE-DNA, which is working on bringing this product to market.

Description of the scientific environment
You will be a member of the Regenberg research team (Regenberg Lab). We explore the biology of circular DNA in eukaryotic systems, taking advantage of our highly sensitive methods for detection and analysis of circular DNA in yeast, animals, and human cancer from whole genome data. You will work in close contact with other scientists in bioinformatics, as well as experimentalists who purify, sequence, and analyze the circular DNA in thousands of plasma and tumor samples from cancer patients. We offer an exciting international work environment in our renowned team, with ample opportunity to develop a strong scientific career and gain insight into the startup world. The project will be carried out at the Section for Ecology and Evolution, Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen.

We expect the candidate to have:

  • Hands on experience with common genomics methods, including whole genome sequencing (WGS)
  • Experience with DNA purification and library preparation
  • A strong understanding of cancer biology is an advantage
  • Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to work well in a team
  • An agile mindset, comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment
  • Structured and strategic thinking
  • Well-organized, with the ability to document their work clearly
  • An interest in startups/spinout ventures
  • Experience from the diagnostic industry or public sector is an advantage
Supervisor is Professor, Birgitte Regenberg, Department of Biology, bregenberg@bio.ku.dk, direct phone: +4535321680.

The position is available for a 16-month period and your key task is to manage and carry on your research project.

Formal requirements
Applicants should hold an MSc in Molecular Biology or a similar discipline, and must be familiar with working independently in the laboratory. Fluency in spoken and written English is a requirement. As criteria for the assessment of your qualifications, emphasis will also be laid on previous publications (if any) and relevant work experience.

Terms of employment
The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically in the UCPH Job Portal.

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
The deadline for applications is 13 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST)
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.
